newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Wolford says first half profit, sales rise. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Austrian Wolford says first half profit, sales rise. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]

text.p: Austrian luxury hosiery and lingerie maker Wolford said on Monday pre-tax profit in the first six months of the business year which ends on April 30 (corrects time frame), 1997 rose to 158.7 million schillings ($14.5 million) from 146.6 million schillings a year ago.
Net profit was up at 106.9 million schillings, compared to 97.7 million, while sales were reported up at 829.3 million schillings versus 764.8 million last year.
Wolford said it expected full-year sales to rise to between 1.65 and 1.7 billion schillings, up from 1.475 billion last year.
The group forecast it would double the number of its stores around the globe to 200 at the end of its business year.
